title: No longer receiving BG Readings
body:
Hi guys, 
I am using the xdrip with the libre sensor and using galaxy s10+ running android 10.
I have switched my sensor last night and it works fine - problem is that i get no readings with the MM to the xdrip app.
It worked fine up until that point with exception that when i first updated to android 10 it stopped working but was fixed thanks to some advice from people here.
I have made sure the MM is fully charged and tried the same workaround that fixed it for me after upgrading to android 10 (f.closed app remove bluetooth data &reconnect) to no avail.
Anyone else had this or can help with this? Should also note MM is connected to xdrip.
Here is a screen from the  logs
